Dad: Have you finished the tasting afternoon?
Eva: Yes, we have just washed up.
Dad: Did you make pizza?
Eva: No, bean curry with rice. I have eaten it before, but this was my first time making it.
Dad: Has Sam tried it before?
Eva: No. He asked our teacher about the ingredients first. Ours had no chilli, so he chose a small portion.
Dad: Did he enjoy it?
Eva: Yes, he asked for another portion.
Dad: Have you taken any photos?
Eva: Yes, of Ruby’s fruit salad. The bowls looked beautiful.
Dad: What will you do next Friday?
Eva: We will make soup. We have not chosen which kind yet.
